paper_title: Balls into bins via local search: cover time and maximum load
statement: 1. For any vertex-transitive graph (not necessarily of bounded degrees), does it hold that (n) Xmax = Θ(R1 ) and Tcov = Θ(R2 n) with high probability? 2. For any vertex-transitive graph (not necessarily of bounded degrees) and any m = ω(nR2 ), (m) does it hold that Xmax = m n + Θ(R2 ) with high probability? 3. For any vertex-transitive graph, is the blanket time of order nR2 for all δ > 1? Also, is the blanket time of the same order as the cover time for all vertex-transitive graphs? 4. Let G = (V, E) and G0 = (V, E 0 ) be two graphs such that E ⊂ E 0 . Is the maximum load on G stochastically dominated by the maximum load on G0 for any m?
